# motherduck_guide (Resource)

Experimental: manages a versioned MotherDuck Guide through public SQL functions. Prefer application deployment tooling for Guide content; this surface is outside the provider's stable support commitment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "motherduck_database" "analytics" {
  name = "analytics"
}

resource "motherduck_table" "invoices" {
  database = motherduck_database.analytics.name
  schema   = "main"
  name     = "invoices"
  columns = {
    invoice_id = "INTEGER"
    amount     = "DOUBLE"
  }
}

resource "motherduck_guide" "revenue" {
  topic          = "metrics/revenue"
  title          = "Revenue metrics"
  description    = "Canonical revenue definitions and source tables"
  access         = "user"
  change_comment = "initial Terraform import"

  content = <<-MARKDOWN
    # Revenue metrics

    Revenue is calculated from finalized invoices.
  MARKDOWN

  references = [
    {
      type        = "catalog"
      url         = "md:analytics"
      schema      = "main"
      table       = "invoices"
      description = "Authoritative invoice source"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Guide Markdown content.
- `title` (String) Human-readable Guide title.

### Optional

- `access` (String) Guide access: `user`, `role`, or `organization`. Organization access requires administrator permission.
- `change_comment` (String) Audit comment attached to the managed Guide version. Changing it appends a version.
- `description` (String) Optional Guide description. Set to an empty string or remove the attribute to clear it.
- `external_id` (String) External identifier attached to the managed Guide version. Changing it appends a version.
- `references` (Attributes List) Catalog, Dive, Flight, or Guide references attached to the managed Guide version. A supplied list replaces the previous version's references. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--references))
- `role_names` (Set of String) Roles that can read the Guide when `access = "role"`. The configured set replaces the previous role audience.
- `topic` (String) Optional slash-separated grouping topic. Set to an empty string or remove the attribute to clear the topic.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Guide creation timestamp.
- `current_version` (Number) Current Guide version number.
- `id` (String) Guide ID assigned by MotherDuck.
- `owner_id` (String) Guide owner ID reported by MotherDuck.
- `owner_name` (String) Guide owner name reported by MotherDuck.
- `updated_at` (String) Guide update timestamp.
- `version_created_at` (String) Current managed version creation timestamp.

<a id="nestedatt--references"></a>
### Nested Schema for `references`

Required:

- `type` (String) Reference type: `catalog`, `dive`, `flight`, or `guide`.

Optional:

- `column` (String) Optional column narrowing for a catalog table reference.
- `description` (String) Optional explanation of why the referenced object is relevant.
- `macro` (String) Optional macro narrowing for a catalog reference.
- `schema` (String) Optional schema narrowing for a catalog reference.
- `table` (String) Optional table narrowing for a catalog reference.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) MotherDuck database or share URL for a catalog reference.
- `uuid` (String) Referenced Dive, Flight, or Guide UUID.
- `view` (String) Optional view narrowing for a catalog reference.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import motherduck_guide.revenue 123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000
```
